prompt: Which guide entry accurately describes Jun’s experience?
promptZh: 哪一則指南內容正確描述了俊的經驗？

options.text: Oak Gate reported adjusting the chime, and Jun heard it chime on the hour after it came back.
options.zh: 橡門回報調整了報時裝置，俊在取回時鐘後聽到它準點報時。
options.whyZh: 俊確實自己聽到準點報時，但橡門只是受理和收款；實際回報調整報時的是雀鈴。

options.text: Finch Bell reported adjusting the chime, and Jun confirmed that the clock keeps time correctly.
options.zh: 雀鈴回報調整了報時裝置，俊也確認時鐘走時準確。
options.whyZh: 實際調整報時的工作室沒錯，但俊還沒檢查一整天的走時情況；準點報時的經驗不能當作已確認全天走時準確。

options.text: Finch Bell reported finishing work on both problems, but Jun has only verified the chime.
options.zh: 雀鈴回報已完成兩項維修，但俊只確認了報時的情況。
options.whyZh: 俊只確認報時的部分沒錯；雀鈴只是說走時問題可能需要後續處理，沒說已經完成。

options.text: Finch Bell reported adjusting the chime, and Jun heard it chime on the hour after it came back.
options.zh: 雀鈴回報調整了報時裝置，俊在取回時鐘後聽到它準點報時。
options.whyZh: 依工作室留言，實際調整的是雀鈴，而非收款的橡門。俊回家後兩次親自確認準點報時，但還沒有驗證全天走時。

explanationZh: 依工作室留言，實際調整的是雀鈴，而非收款的橡門。俊回家後兩次親自確認準點報時，但還沒有驗證全天走時。

vocabulary.note: 受理或收款人與實際修理人可不同；再區分作業回報和物主親自觀察。

evidence: An intake shop may book a job and take payment without doing the work. Name that shop as the intake contact, but attribute each repair to the workshop that performed it. A workshop’s message is enough to say what it reports having done. Do not describe a result as verified unless the owner has actually checked that result after getting the clock back. / Jun paid Oak Gate when leaving a clock whose chime was unreliable. Oak Gate forwarded it to Finch Bell. Finch Bell’s message says it adjusted the chime and noted that a separate timekeeping problem might need a later visit. At home, Jun heard it chime on the hour twice. Jun has not yet checked whether the clock keeps time correctly over an entire day.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: An intake shop may book a job and take payment without doing the work. Name that shop as the intake contact, but attribute each repair to the workshop that performed it. A workshop’s message is enough to say what it reports having done. Do not describe a result as verified unless the owner has actually checked that result after getting the clock back.

Jun paid Oak Gate when leaving a clock whose chime was unreliable. Oak Gate forwarded it to Finch Bell. Finch Bell’s message says it adjusted the chime and noted that a separate timekeeping problem might need a later visit. At home, Jun heard it chime on the hour twice. Jun has not yet checked whether the clock keeps time correctly over an entire day.
